_notes: Every font (FONTRES resource) of the official UQM 0.8.0 content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef) as UQM's own _GetFontData loads it, with images read by libpng as SDL_image reads them, and texts laid out by UQM's TextRect and _text_blt (see tools/extract/golden/fonts.c). Fonts are content (CC BY-NC-SA 2.5), so everything here is a SHA-256 of compact JSON.
fonts: by folder. metrics: [Leading, LeadingWidth]. glyphs: by character number, [char, width, height, hot_x, hot_y, disp_width, disp_height, alpha as lowercase hex].
resources: the FONTRES ids and the folder each names.

texts: a text (our own, in hex, or a game string by number) laid out in a font with an alignment (0 left, 1 center, 2 right) at baseline 0, 0. result: [[TextRect's result (1 or 0), corner x, corner y, width, height, CharCount], then each character drawn, [char, pen x, pen y]].
